text: Patient presented with acute hypertension. Prescribed Amoxicillin 500mg orally twice daily and Lisinopril 10mg daily for 14 days.
Diagnosed with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus. Administered Metformin 850mg after meals. Patient reports mild dizziness.
Patient admitted with community-acquired pneumonia. Prescribed Azithromycin 500mg once daily for 5 days and advised to maintain adequate hydration.
Presented with acute migraine without aura. Treated with Sumatriptan 50mg as needed and advised to avoid known dietary triggers.
Diagnosed with iron-deficiency anemia. Started Ferrous Sulfate 325mg orally once daily and advised to follow up for repeat blood work in 6 weeks.
Patient evaluated for urinary tract infection. Prescribed Nitrofurantoin 100mg twice daily for 7 days and instructed to increase fluid intake.
Admitted for asthma exacerbation. Symptoms improved after nebulized bronchodilator therapy. Discharged with Albuterol inhaler, 2 puffs every 4 to 6 hours as needed.
Patient presented with gastroesophageal reflux symptoms. Started Omeprazole 20mg before breakfast daily and advised on dietary modifications.
Diagnosed with acute bacterial sinusitis. Prescribed Amoxicillin-Clavulanate 875/125mg twice daily for 10 days and recommended saline nasal irrigation.
Patient discharged after evaluation for musculoskeletal back pain. Recommended Ibuprofen 400mg every 8 hours with food as needed and gentle stretching exercises.
